Confirmed directly on Khalifa University's own brand page (ku.ac.ae/media/visual-identity-and-branding-guidelines) that logo/branding assets require contacting the Communications and Business Development Department — written permission is explicitly required, consistent with the original hold reason. A Commons file (File:Khalifa University New Logo.png) claims CC BY-SA 4.0, but it was self-declared "own work" by an unaffiliated Commons uploader (Rem1706) merely citing ku.ac.ae as the source — a common Commons mislabeling pattern for corporate trademarks, not a verifiable release by the rights holder — so it was not used. No written-permission workflow was pursued per instructions.
